mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND SNOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -3 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY SNOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND SNOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY SNOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND SNOW_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) AND date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY SNOW_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND SNOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SNOW), '-99999') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND SNOW_DATE BETWEEN CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SNOW), '-99999') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE FROM snow_hist WHERE SNOW_DATE BETWEEN CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 23:59:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SNOW), '-99999') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE FROM snow_hist WHERE SNOW_DATE BETWEEN CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -2 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(date_add(now(), interval -2 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 23:59:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'N' AND SNOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m'), '-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(SNOW, '-') AS SNOW, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM snow_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'Y' AND SNOW_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y'), '-01-01 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}
